title: Git Sources
subtitle: Connect GitHub, or another Git host, to deploy private repositories.
name: Name
privateRepoDesc: Deploy a private repo through a connected GitHub App or Gitea / Forgejo / Codeberg token.
baseUrlHint: https://git.example.com — the instance root, https only.
tokenHint: Write-only — it cannot be viewed after saving.
shareHint: Every team can then use this connection to import and deploy the repositories it can see. Only the instance owner can change this.
noSources: One click on GitHub is all it takes. Other hosts are under Advanced.
connectGithubHint: Tugra opens GitHub with everything filled in. You click Create, then Install.
orgInvalid: Use letters, numbers and single hyphens.
appNameHint: Shown on GitHub. It must be unique there.
anyAccount: Allow other accounts and organizations to install it
anyAccountHint: Off keeps the App private to its owner.
autoFilled: What Tugra fills in for you
autoRedirect: Redirect URL: where GitHub sends you after you click Create.
autoSetup: Setup URL: where GitHub sends you after you install the App.
autoWebhook: Webhook URL: where GitHub reports pushes, so deploys can start by themselves. It is signed with a secret only Tugra and GitHub know.
webhookOff: This hub is not reachable from the internet, so push-to-deploy is off. Set a public URL for the hub, then reconnect.
addAccountHint: Install it on another account or organization.
noRepos: No repositories yet. Install the App on some.
advancedHint: Add a GitHub App you created yourself, or connect Gitea, Forgejo or Codeberg.
manualHint: Paste its IDs and drop its private key. Tugra shows the webhook URL once it is added.
manualAppIdHint: The number on the App's settings page.
manualInstallationIdHint: From the install page URL. Optional.
manualWebhookSecretHint: The secret you set for the App's webhook. Optional.
pemDrop: Drop the .pem file here, or choose it
pemInvalid: That file is not a private key.
tokenHint2: Use a personal access token with read access to repositories.
returnOkManifest: Created. Taking you to GitHub to install it…
returnError: This link has expired or was already used. Start again from Git Sources.
returnNothing: GitHub did not send anything back. Start again from Git Sources.
